selected.name: SuperTokens
selected.rationale: An excellent developer-centric open-source authentication solution. It is highly suitable for a two-person bootstrapped startup because it can be self-hosted for free to conserve the 4-month runway, yet provides straightforward SDKs to implement email/password, Google SSO, and multi-tenant RBAC quickly.

selected.name: Logto
selected.rationale: A modern open-source alternative to Auth0 that offers a polished out-of-the-box sign-in UI (Omni sign-in) supporting multiple languages. It is highly developer-friendly, reducing frontend implementation time for a small team, and can be self-hosted to keep pre-revenue infrastructure costs at zero.

selected.name: Keycloak
selected.rationale: A highly mature, battle-tested open-source IAM solution that fully supports complex multi-tenancy (realms) and RBAC. While extremely robust and completely free to self-host, its steep learning curve and heavier operational overhead should be carefully weighed against the startup's tight 4-month runway.
